description: "State of the Union Addresses" by Chester Alan Arthur is a collection of presidential addresses reflecting on the state of the nation and its foreign relations, written during the late 19th century. It encompasses the official messages presented by Arthur to the United States Congress, providing insight into the political climate, economic conditions, and notable national events of his presidency.
